input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: First full run of E32 hung in src/logic.py's fo_model on the 19-claim positions (backtracking without propagation); stopped it and checked position consistency by SAT with the model re-evaluated by logic.py's evaluator instead.
integrity_issues: The pre-registered claim-set line in LOG.md miscounts (26 claims, 13 shared, 10 facts; actual 25, 12, 9). Left as written, with a correction in the outcome bullet.
Prediction (e) missed: Vatican I's ecumenicity is in 4 conflicts, not 5; reported.

Every attribution of a definition to a document (Lyon II, Laetentur caeli, Trent s.25, Pastor Aeternus, the two bulls, the 1895 Encyclical) is from the standard histories and unchecked: newadvent.org, vatican.va, papalencyclicals.net and wikisource.org were all refused. Marked (unchecked) in the code, results, README and post.

doc_friction.issue: Drew theism-formal-evidence, whose last ~20 steps all went to one sub-question (Anderson separability); nothing in the draw output says which hypotheses of the proposal are untested, so the run had to read the whole LOG to find that H3 had only been tested on two disputes.

fo_model's docstring calls it exact (true) but not that it is exponential without unit propagation: 19 monadic claims did not finish in minutes. A note pointing to E32's SAT grounding would save the next run the timeout.

deviations.why: Every recent entry's next step was more Anderson-separability work (size-bound proof, timing, Hajek); the proposal's own central church-level question (H3) had been tested on two disputes only.
deviations.did: Took H3 instead: seven disputes in one claim set.
deviations.result: A pre-registered refutation of H3 at the Immaculate Conception and a five-claim minimum crux list.

notes: Local checks: pytest test_theism.py 42 passed (python3.13 with PySAT 1.9.dev24); research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links ok; check_md_links ok; programme_check ok; check_posts ok. Enumeration 0.12 s.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a philosopher of religion encoding 25 claims, enumerating conflicts by hand and writing it up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
